died.name: Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester
died.cause: before dying at the Battle of Evesham
died.last_words: By the arm of St. James, it is time to die.

died.name: Sebastian of Portugal
died.cause: when being advised to surrender, and to hand over his sword to the victors of the Battle of Alcácer Quibir
died.last_words: Royal freedom will only be lost with life

died.name: Hans Christian Andersen
died.last_words: Don't ask me how I am! I understand nothing more.

died.name: Noel Godfrey Chavasse
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Passchendaele in World War I. He was reminding a nurse of their earlier conversation about contacting his father and fiancée and about his younger brother, who was missing in action
died.last_words: Do not forget what I have told you.

died.name: Ivy Taylor
died.cause: The 12-year-old girl from Blackburn, Lancashire, died from ulceration of air passages after ingesting sodium silicate jelly inside a golf ball.

died.name: Marilyn Monroe
died.cause: over the phone to Peter Lawford, John F. Kennedy's brother-in-law
died.last_words: Say goodbye to Pat, say goodbye to the president and say goodbye to yourself, because you're a nice guy... I'll see... I'll see.

born.name: Edward Irving
born.last_words: If I die, I die unto the Lord. Amen.

born.name: Oliver P. Morton
born.desc: Governor of Indiana and United States Senator
born.last_words: I am dying, I am worn out.
